## About
European Autowerks is a neighborhood repair shop on S Roberts Rd in Palos Hills. We service foreign and domestic cars, all makes and models, and our goal is simple: honest, quality service in a timely manner.
Slobo and his team handle everything from routine maintenance and diagnostics to engine, clutch and transmission work. Customers tell us they appreciate that we explain what needs to get done and why, and some keep coming back even after moving away.
We serve Palos Hills and nearby communities like Worth, Chicago Ridge, Hickory Hills and Oak Lawn, and towing is available to the shop. We're rated 4.5 from 111 Google reviews.

## Services
- Oil changes and routine maintenance: Oil changes, routine maintenance and engine diagnostics to keep your car running right.
- Transmission repair and rebuild: Transmission repair work, including full rebuilds.
- Air conditioning service: A/C service to keep your car comfortable through Chicago summers.

## FAQ
Q: Do you only work on European cars?
A: No. We service both foreign and domestic vehicles, all makes and models.

Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open 8:00 am to 5:00 pm, Monday through Friday. We're closed on weekends.

Q: Which areas do you serve?
A: We're located in Palos Hills and serve nearby communities including Worth, Chicago Ridge, Palos Heights, Palos Park, Hickory Hills, Burbank, Crestwood and Justice.
